MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p, STRPTIME(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS birth
WHERE (p.nationality = 'Slovenian' AND p.birth_date <> '1994/6/6')
   OR (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 2 AND birth < DATE('1948-10-14'))
RETURN p.nationality AS col1,
       p.birth_date AS col2,
       DATE_DIFF('year', birth, DATE('2026-10-14')) AS col3,
       p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
  CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH p,
  birth_year,
  birth_month,
  birth_day,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE (p.nationality = 'Slovenian' AND p.birth_date <> '1994/6/6')
   OR (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 2 AND age > 78)
RETURN p.nationality AS col1,
       p.birth_date AS col2,
       age AS col3,
       p.name AS name_player
